profile.headline: Embedded Systems Software Engineer at Virtuix

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created and deployed software for embedded devices and systems from requirements to production and commercial deployment of the Virtuix Omni One Omni Directional Treadmill. 
• Selected cost effective components while performing schematic capture for sensor PCB designs  
• Designed and optimized PCB layouts for sensor boards using Eagle CAD 
• Developed and optimized embedded software drivers for sensor PCBs, enhancing device accuracy and reliability in production.
• Created automated test fixtures in Fusion 360, reducing PCB validation time by 40%  
• Developed a Python-based video stability correction application for the Virtuix Omni Arena, improving image processing efficiency by 25%.  
• Tested and approved various replacement components for the Virtuix Omni Arena commercial attraction  
• Streamlined Omni Arena Computer Cabinet production, reducing assembly time by 60%  
• Wrote application software and drivers for production line test fixtures
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Engineering · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · C · Raspberry Pi

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on embedded system design software team for vending machine tracking on the web  
• Designed and implemented a command-line-driven cable test fixture in Atmel Studio, reducing testing time
• Designed PCB in Eagle CAD for small Audio Amplifier board  
• Engineered a durable and cost-effective enclosure for an audio amplifier using Creo  
• Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to develop a Point of Sale (POS) Kiosk, enhancing payment security and improving user experience.  
• Provided technical assistance for customers in a Field Engineering role  
• Authored comprehensive installation and troubleshooting guides for customers  
• Validated the company manufacturing test procedures
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · C · Linux · Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a mechanical test fixture with a user-friendly graphical UI, reducing production testing time by 60%
• Developed embedded software for tracking a rotating harness using Hall Effect sensors, enhancing motion tracking 
• Executed rigorous mechanical and electrical verification testing on the Virtuix Omni, ensuring compliance with safety and performance standards
• Created mechanical test fixtures for lifetime durability testing, identifying design flaws early and increasing part longevity
• Managed an in-house production line for early adopters 
• Gained experience in international shipping and packaging 
• Represented Virtuix Inc. at trade shows, providing technical demonstrations and increasing customer engagement
positions.insights: Skills: Git · .NET Framework · Bash · C · Embedded Software · C#

positions.title: Systems Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Created signal integrity tests for SATA/Calxeda fabric lanes for Calxeda systems  
• Helped Calxeda Field Application Engineers with specific customer needs  
• Conducted board bring-up and system verification for server nodes, identifying and resolving hardware issues to improve reliability.
• Developed and enhanced a Linux-based testing suite, streamlining system diagnostics and reducing testing time
• Designed and validated fan baffle systems, optimizing airflow and reducing thermal load

positions.title: Mathematics/Physics Tutor
positions.description:
• Provided one-on-one and group tutoring in mathematics and physics, improving student performance and retention rates.
• Applied advanced tutoring techniques learned in annual training seminars to enhance student comprehension and engagement.

positions.title: Certified Air Traffic Controller
positions.description:
• Organized and expedited the flow of air traffic in the ATC Tower system
• Developed strong leadership skills as shift supervisor
• Trained junior controllers in the ATC Tower in “on the job” and classroom setting
